externalReply.text: Mara, the size of this invoice and the $600 already taken have created an unacceptable uncertainty for Aster and its clients. Bank posting normally takes five to ten business days after processor acceptance; that timing is an estimate.

The current incident collection hold ends March 3 at 18:00 UTC. Niko will arrange an extension through March 8 at 18:00 while processing completes and confirm it today. It protects incident collection, not new usage or the separate March 4 monthly renewal. No annual upgrade is required for this relief. Team Plus adds allowance and support routing but does not cap spending or settle this invoice.

Engineering will replace only Linden's video with the lightweight notice you authorized, verify it, and report back today. Essential information pages will remain in place. This should reduce exposure, but cached or other traffic may continue and no zero-spend guarantee is available. A partial request sample shows concentrated file requests; it does not establish a malicious attack or final cause. Security's next update is March 4 at 16:00 UTC. The team will provide a useful minimized account explanation rather than raw visitor identifiers. The fee adjustment does not close that request or require a release. If you prefer to leave, the team can arrange export and nonrenewal after your explicit instruction; no cancellation has been requested or submitted.
